import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static long[][] comb = new long[62][62];
    static long[][] A = new long[32][32];
    static long[][] B = new long[32][32];
    static long TT;
    static int R, C, n;
    static char[] p;
    static long[][] CC = new long[32][32];
    static long MM;
    static ArrayList<Pair>[][] P = new ArrayList[32][2];
    static ArrayList<Pair>[][] Q = new ArrayList[32][2];
    static long Res;

    static class Pair implements Comparable<Pair> {
        long first, second;
        Pair(long f, long s) { first = f; second = s; }
        public int compareTo(Pair o) {
            if (first < o.first) return -1;
            if (first > o.first) return 1;
            return 0;
        }
    }

    static void put(int x, int y, long g, long c1, long c2, int ck) {
        if (x + y == R + n) {
            P[x][ck].add(new Pair(g, c1));
            if (c2 != 0) Q[x][ck].add(new Pair(g, c2));
            return;
        }
        put(x + 1, y, g + (ck == 0 ? A[x + 1][y] : 0), c1, (p[x + y] != 'B' ? c2 : 0), ck);
        put(x, y + 1, g + (ck == 1 ? B[x][y + 1] : 0), c1, (p[x + y] != 'A' ? c2 : 0), ck);
    }

    static void calc1(int x, int y, long g, int ck) {
        if (x + y == R + n) {
            if (P[x][ck].isEmpty()) return;
            int t = lowerBound(P[x][ck], (TT + 1) / 2 - g);
            if (t != P[x][ck].size() && P[x][ck].get(t).second > 0) {
                long tp = (P[x][ck].get(t).first + g) * 2 - TT;
                if (tp < 0) tp = -tp;
                if (MM > tp) MM = tp;
            }
            if (t > 0 && P[x][ck].get(t - 1).second > 0) {
                long tp = (P[x][ck].get(t - 1).first + g) * 2 - TT;
                if (tp < 0) tp = -tp;
                if (MM > tp) MM = tp;
            }
            return;
        }
        calc1(x - 1, y, g + (ck == 0 ? A[x][y] : 0), ck);
        calc1(x, y - 1, g + (ck == 1 ? B[x][y] : 0), ck);
    }

    static void calc2(int x, int y, long g, int ck) {
        if (x + y == R + n) {
            int t = lowerBound(Q[x][ck], (TT + 1) / 2 - g);
            if (t != Q[x][ck].size() && Q[x][ck].get(t).second > 0) {
                long tp = (Q[x][ck].get(t).first + g) * 2 - TT;
                if (tp < 0) tp = -tp;
                if (MM == tp) Res += Q[x][ck].get(t).second;
            }
            if (t > 0 && Q[x][ck].get(t - 1).second > 0) {
                long tp = (Q[x][ck].get(t - 1).first + g) * 2 - TT;
                if (tp < 0) tp = -tp;
                if (MM == tp) Res += Q[x][ck].get(t - 1).second;
            }
            return;
        }
        if (p[x + y - 1] != 'B') calc2(x - 1, y, g + (ck == 0 ? A[x][y] : 0), ck);
        if (p[x + y - 1] != 'A') calc2(x, y - 1, g + (ck == 1 ? B[x][y] : 0), ck);
    }

    static void make(ArrayList<Pair> vec) {
        if (vec.isEmpty()) return;
        Collections.sort(vec);
        int cnt = 0;
        long s = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < vec.size(); ++i) {
            s += vec.get(i).second;
            if (i + 1 == vec.size() || vec.get(i).first != vec.get(i + 1).first) {
                vec.set(cnt++, new Pair(vec.get(i).first, s));
                s = 0;
            }
        }
        while (vec.size() > cnt) vec.remove(vec.size() - 1);
    }

    static int lowerBound(ArrayList<Pair> list, long key) {
        int lo = 0, hi = list.size();
        while (lo < hi) {
            int mid = (lo + hi) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid).first < key) lo = mid + 1;
            else hi = mid;
        }
        return lo;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        R = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        C = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        p = br.readLine().toCharArray();
        n = R + C;

        for (int i = 0; i <= 60; ++i) {
            comb[i][0] = 1;
            for (int j = 1; j <= i; ++j)
                comb[i][j] = comb[i - 1][j - 1] + comb[i - 1][j];
        }

        TT = comb[n * 2][R * 2];

        for (int i = 0; i <= n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= n; ++j) {
                if (i > 0) A[i][j] = comb[i - 1][R - 1] * (comb[n * 2 - i][R] - comb[j][R]);
                if (j > 0) B[i][j] = comb[j - 1][R - 1] * (comb[n * 2 - j][R] - comb[i][R]);
            }
        }

        CC[0][0] = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= n; ++j) {
                if (i != n && p[i + j] != 'B') CC[i + 1][j] += CC[i][j];
                if (j != n && p[i + j] != 'A') CC[i][j + 1] += CC[i][j];
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < 32; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 2; ++j) {
                P[i][j] = new ArrayList<>();
                Q[i][j] = new ArrayList<>();
            }
        }

        for (int i = R; i <= n; ++i) {
            if (p[i + R - 1] != 'B') put(R, i, A[R][i], comb[i + R - 1][R - 1], CC[R - 1][i], 0);
            if (p[i + R - 1] != 'A') put(i, R, B[i][R], comb[i + R - 1][R - 1], CC[i][R - 1], 1);
        }

        for (int i = R; i <= n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 2; ++j) {
                make(P[i][j]);
                make(Q[i][j]);
            }
        }

        MM = TT + 1;
        calc1(n, n, 0, 0);
        calc1(n, n, 0, 1);
        calc2(n, n, 0, 0);
        calc2(n, n, 0, 1);

        System.out.println(Res);
    }
}
